about: Mars's planned ground round the first expedition's camp in the game 2099 (its game/world/ground/mars_plan.json and mars_plan_heights.png, Ground.PLAN_* and Worlds.RADIUS): the same square, sixteen-bit encoding and ball radius as the Moon's plan, laid on the camp seat (FirstExpedition.CAMP_FACING_OUT, heading 0). The camp's kit (data/kit/camp.json) is the habitat's own frame: the habitat stands 0.55 m over the ground under the seat's middle (ExpeditionCamp.HABITAT_FLOOR_RISE_M), turned -130.5 degrees about up (rad(-40.5) - pi/2), so its entry has that heading and a `lift`; the grounds' (campgrounds) is the camp seat itself. The skin is a shade map: the game paints Mars's ground its MARS_DUST colour (#b4583a, mars_ground.tres) shaded by it, so the stage tints the skin to that colour (`tint`).
